products.label: JPL Small-Body Database, main-belt orbit classes
products.process: Take every inner, main and outer main-belt asteroid of absolute magnitude 13 or brighter that has no object package and a condition code of 6 or better; carry its osculating orbit to the world's epoch as an unperturbed ellipse; draw one dot at that position.
limitations: Only the brighter asteroids are drawn; the fainter ones, the great majority, are left out.
No colour is taken from the database; every dot is the neutral grey the app gives a body without a measured colour, and its size and opacity are display choices.
